clue.text: Journey to church to take in extremely trendy altarpiece

parts.note: a journey is a trip

indicators.note: extremely points to the extremities of trendy, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A traveller heads to church to see a very fashionable painting over the altar.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-panelled painting is a classic form of altar decoration in churches.

clue.text: Angler's aid to secure river fish

parts.note: R is the map abbreviation for river
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: A fisherman uses his gear to land a river fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to secure' only links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A fishing rod carries a spool for winding in the line, an essential piece of tackle.

clue.text: They may deliver crude verse to accompany instrument

indicators.note: to accompany puts the verse beside the instrument, so the two are joined

parts.note: a pipe is a wind instrument
lines of poetry make verse

explanation.surface: Rough poetry delivered to a musical accompaniment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crude' looks like it describes the verse, but it is crude oil.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil companies send crude petroleum long distances through tubes laid over land or sea.

clue.text: Chap in court once noted for efficient service

definitions.text: Chap in court once noted for efficient service

parts.words: Chap in court once noted for efficient service
parts.note: an attendant in a royal household of old, whose name lives on in the phrase for good, dependable service

explanation.surface: A former royal attendant remembered for his reliability.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yeoman service' is an idiom for loyal, useful help; yeomen were also attendants in royal households.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically a servant or attendant in a noble or royal household, proverbial for sterling service.

clue.text: Ancient invaders of Hastings hard on English in rout

indicators.note: a rout is a disorderly flight, so the letters scatter into a new order

explanation.surface: Early invaders defeated at Hastings, with the English in disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface evokes the Battle of Hastings of 1066; 'in rout' rearranges HASTINGS, HARD, ON and E.
explanation.definitionFit: These two brothers led the Jutes who, by legend, invaded Britain in the fifth century.

clue.text: Failing to swerve when learner driver pulls out

indicators.note: pulls out means that piece is withdrawn from the longer word

parts.note: to deflect is to swerve or turn aside
L is the learner plate shown by a learner driver in Britain

explanation.surface: A motorist fails to swerve as a learner pulls out in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A failing is a flaw or shortcoming, a noun sense shared with a fault.

clue.text: Planner of animal enclosure for the Lion, say

indicators.note: the animal forms an enclosure for the sign, which sits inside it

parts.note: a deer is an animal
Leo the Lion is a sign of the zodiac, given here as an example

explanation.surface: Someone planning a zoo pen for a lion.
explanation.definitionFit: A designer draws up the plans for a product, building or garment.

clue.text: Sources of some poisons provided to hold animal up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the whole piece is read from bottom to top
the conditional word holds the animal inside it

parts.note: provided, as in on condition that, means if
a gnu is an African antelope

explanation.surface: Poisons are provided to bring an animal to a halt.
explanation.definitionFit: Many mushrooms and toadstools are toxic, so these organisms are a source of poisons.

clue.text: Device responsible for hold-up on rail

definitions.text: Device responsible for hold-up on rail

parts.words: Device responsible for hold-up on rail
parts.note: reads like a railway robbery, but describes the item that holds up clothes on a wardrobe rail

explanation.surface: Something that causes a delay to trains.
explanation.definitionFit: A shaped wire or wooden frame keeps a garment suspended from the rail in a wardrobe.

clue.text: Again provides with work in harvest periods

parts.note: to harvest crops is to reap them
a period or full stop is also called a point

explanation.surface: A farmer rehires workers at harvest time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' only links definition and wordplay; 'periods' is punctuation, not spans of time.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone a post again is to reinstate them in a job.

clue.text: Niggardly approach

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both close-fisted with money and to draw close.

clue.text: Luminary, as was the star of Bethlehem

definitions.text: as was the star of Bethlehem
definitions.meaning: the star guided the Magi, literally a light that went ahead

explanation.definitionFit: A prominent person is figuratively a guiding lamp, and the Bethlehem star literally guided the wise men.

clue.text: Weather adviser about to be recruited by woodman

indicators.note: the short word is taken into the woodman, so it goes inside it

parts.note: a forester is a woodman
CA, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A forester takes on a weather expert.
explanation.definitionFit: A meteorologist predicts rain and sun, advising the public on the outlook.

clue.text: Advance look before article appears

indicators.note: before places the look word ahead of the article

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone takes a sneak preview before a newspaper piece is published.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appears' only links; 'Advance' is a noun, money lent.
explanation.definitionFit: An advance of money is a sum lent to be repaid later.

clue.text: Taking steps to conserve energy in traffic

indicators.note: the trading word conserves, that is keeps inside it, the energy letter

parts.note: to traffic is to trade, so traffic as a noun is trading
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Measures taken to save fuel in road traffic.
explanation.definitionFit: To walk is to place one foot after another, literally stepping.

clue.text: Run down entering gate, in red convertible

indicators.note: convertible means able to be changed, so the letters are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A red convertible car drives through a gate and knocks someone over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'convertible' looks like the red car; it rearranges GATE, IN and RED. 'entering' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: To run someone down is to belittle or disparage them.

clue.text: Cheat punished and shut away

parts.note: a con is a cheat or swindle
fined means punished with a monetary penalty

explanation.surface: A cheat is punished and locked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone locked in is kept within limits, imprisoned or restricted.

clue.text: Adjusts feathers and lands

parts.note: to set something is to adjust it
down is soft fine feathers

explanation.surface: A bird preens its plumage and comes in to land.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft that touches down on the runway is said to put down or land.

clue.text: Recognises, so to speak, parliamentary opposition

indicators.note: so to speak signals that a word is said out loud and spelt differently

parts.note: to know someone is to recognise them

explanation.surface: A Speaker acknowledges the opposition benches in the Commons.
explanation.walkthrough: In a Commons vote those against shout their verdict and are counted in a separate lobby.
explanation.definitionFit: The votes against a motion in Parliament are counted as the opposing side.

clue.text: A beginning to delivery service for potential customers

indicators.note: the beginning to delivery is its first letter

parts.note: Mass is a church service

explanation.surface: The start of a home delivery service for prospective buyers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' only links. 'service' is a church service, not a business.
explanation.definitionFit: The mass audience targeted by advertising is the public seen as buyers.

clue.text: Yet another drink? Forgo it with h-head bursting

indicators.note: bursting breaks the letters apart so they can be reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: A hungover drinker with a pounding head is told to skip one more.
explanation.walkthrough: The stammered 'h-head' supplies an extra H to the letters of FORGO, IT and HHEAD.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a further alcoholic drink taken to cure a hangover.

clue.text: Dressing not entirely right for bird

indicators.note: not entirely means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: robing is the act of dressing in robes

explanation.surface: A salad dressing that is not quite right for poultry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right for' only joins wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The red-breasted songbird is a common garden species.

clue.text: American's exclamation about line in song

indicators.note: about means the exclamation goes round the next piece

parts.note: gee is a mild American exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: An American cries out at a lyric in a song.
explanation.definitionFit: A part-song for unaccompanied male voices, popular in the eighteenth century, is a kind of song.

clue.text: Attempt to bring cuckoo back

indicators.note: back means the crazy word is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: bats, like cuckoo, means crazy

explanation.surface: Trying to lure a cuckoo back home.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a stab at something is having a go or try.

clue.text: Island's return fare okay for relation

indicators.note: return means the island's name is turned round

parts.note: Arran is a Scottish island in the Firth of Clyde
the food on offer, the fare, is the table

explanation.surface: An island's return ferry fare is acceptable to a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relation' is telling a story, not a relative; 'return' looks like a ticket.
explanation.definitionFit: A story fit to be told is capable of being recounted.

clue.text: Cut fruit served before start of dinner

indicators.note: before places the fruit ahead of the next piece

parts.note: a prune is a dried plum, a fruit

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of dinner

explanation.surface: Sliced fruit is served ahead of the evening meal.
explanation.definitionFit: To trim branches or text is to cut it back.

clue.text: Read-out covering all points was found satisfactory

indicators.note: the shuffled word covers, or surrounds, the compass points
out means the letters of read are put out of order

parts.note: north, south, west and east are all the points of the compass

explanation.surface: A printout covering every item proved acceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Read-out' looks like a printout, but 'out' is the anagram signal working on the word before it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that answered the purpose served it well enough.
